tn_squeezework.blurb: Squeezework is a compact pocket of bouldering in the Upper Middle Creek section of Middle Creek, near Chattanooga, Tennessee. About ten problems share an overhanging wall of orange-coloured stone with some interesting features, and most lines finish without a true top-out. Grades begin around V2 and reach V9, with the bulk of the problems between V5 and V7, so it rewards stronger boulderers more than newcomers. Reaching it means following the main path along the creek from the road, which the wider Middle Creek zone rates at roughly ten minutes on foot. The V6 that gives the zone its name is one of its best-known lines.

tn_downstream_area.blurb: Downstream Area is a sandstone stretch of cliff in the Blue Heron section of Big South Fork, Tennessee. It runs for around 300 metres at the base of the wall, in the gap between a training wall and a pair of freestanding pillars. Ten routes split evenly between sport and trad, with grades from 5.8 to 5.11 and a solid helping of 5.10s and 5.11s. Most lines are well rated, which makes it a worthwhile stop for climbers working through the middle grades who want a mix of protection styles on one wall.
